comment: Identical architectures made optimizer progress and late-stage rate sensitivity decisive. K1001/K1002 supported D over the much slower Adagrad C, and B over both. For the trained group, B's AdamW recipe was preferred over high-rate, coupled-decay RMSprop; A's lower RMSprop rate was preferred over E's larger displacement at 1024 steps. K1070 cautioned against a universal RMSprop advantage, while K1096 provided only indirect easy-spiral support because its budget was shorter. The gold supports this recipe-specific ordering, not a general RMSprop learning-rate ceiling or an isolated weight-decay effect.
